name: Transglobe Foods Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, TransglobeFood Ltd is engaged in providing food products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
TGFL is in the business of dealing in:
a) Food grains
b) Fruits
c) Vegetables
d) Various types of Fruit Jams
e) Tomato ketchup pastes, purees, etc.
f) Varieties of pickles
It is involved in the manufacturing, processing, importing, and exporting of vegetarian and non-vegetarian processed foods. These include 
products derived from grains, cereals, seeds, vegetables, fruits, plants, oilseeds, edible
 oils, meals, fish, and eggs.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
